stories.title: WNBA Power Rankings: Time running out as teams jockey for playoff seeds
stories.summary: The time to nitpick every win and loss has arrived, as some teams need a dramatic run to reach the playoffs.

stories.title: Bears' Bryant has knee surgery, out 4-6 months
stories.summary: Bears safety Coby Bryant underwent knee surgery and is expected to miss four to six months, coach Ben Johnson announced Tuesday.

stories.title: Vikings name Murray starting QB over McCarthy
stories.summary: The Vikings have named Kyler Murray the team's starting quarterback over J.J. McCarthy.

stories.title: KC's Rice: Jail sentence was 'learning experience'
stories.summary: Chiefs receiver Rashee Rice says his 30-day jail sentence earlier this year was a "learning experience and a reality check."

stories.title: Jets CB Stiggers collapses at practice, hospitalized
stories.summary: Jets cornerback Qwan'tez Stiggers was transported by ambulance to a hospital after collapsing during a joint practice Tuesday with the Buccaneers.
